notes: The reward economy the sim PAYS (never spends - the scouting machine and the open mat spend Prestige since PAC-098): NP_11 s6's currency matrix at its launch baselines, NP_02 s2's rewards per size, NP_08 s2.4's Prestige and s5's Kizuna. A reward ledger rides with the sim beside the PI ledger - XP per fighter, Spirits, Prestige, HBP, Kizuna per pair - paid on the sim's own end paths (bout_end, seg_end, dual_end) and returned with it, hashed. Beans never come from the sim (training slots are the overworld's). The per-event XP amounts, the Spirits by result, the HBP for a win and the Kizuna level thresholds are first-draft design values; the shapes are the docs' (XP continuous from the fight, Spirits 3-8 for spars and duals, Prestige +1-3 per scrap, the +50% reserve rate, the houseless +10%, the tell-highlight lab's -50%, Kizuna's sources and the +15/day soft cap that duals bypass). Since PAC-099 the stable roles pay too (NP_08 s1): a scout's district its Prestige when the day turns, a training partner his Beans in the slot. Since PAC-100 the locker room releases a bench card: the place freed, three days to take the card back, then back to the district or the open mat with a grudge or warmth. Since PAC-101 district rep: a scrap won in a district raises it, a flee costs it, its milestones pay Prestige, REP() reads it.

xp.pace_text: PAC-098: every payment above times the pace (NP_11 s2's curve is canon - level 50 at 120k, a story-pace player at ~35 by Arc 3; C51's playthrough paid a story-pace captain level 21 at the amounts alone). One number, so the amounts keep their proportions

spirits.text: PAC-098: NP_11 s6's 'Spirits 3-8 (spars/duals)' is a session's (NP_02 s5's 45 minutes: a story dual's share and a spar and a half), not a fight's - a spar pays 2, a dual 5 or 8

prestige.text: NP_11 s6: scouting machine pulls (10); NP_08 s2.4: every 10th pull a rare-tier lead

hbp.text: PAC-098: NP_11 s6's HBP comes from 'quests, wins, story' (NP_02 s4: quests pay HBP) - a story beat pays 50 and a quest step 30 when its flag lands (story_mark), the wins as before

scouting.text: NP_08 s2.4's scouting machines (downtown and the community centre): Prestige-fed, a pull dispenses a recruit lead (a card: silhouette, House hint, district), never a person; every 10th pull a rare-tier lead - a named recruit the club has not met (the recruit table's, never excepted) or the String Wall's lead the docs give a condition, turned face up; the rest point to the open mat's generic recruits (NP_04 s9's assembler, the tier by the circuit's flags), signed free on an open-mat day (every 7th, calendar-cycled) or any day for NP_11 s6's open-mat priority (10 Prestige); the stable holds 100 (NP_08 s1). The district names are NP_02 s1.1's; the cadence and the priority's price are first drafts

training.text: NP_08 s1: a training partner's 'Beans bonus keyed to their stats' - a partner better than the trainee at the game's stat (its bias; Shadow Rounds' 'any': the stat he leads by most) adds 1 Bean for every 10 points of the lead, 3 at most, typed as that stat (NP_11 s7: 'partner choice adds their stat flavor'); a partner no better than the trainee adds nothing. A slot that names no partner takes along the club's training partner with the most to add; a partner along without the role flavours as before

scout.text: NP_08 s1: a scout's 'passive Prestige from their home district' - each district the bench's scouts cover pays 1 Prestige when the day turns (a district pays once, however many scouts it has); NP_10 s3: a scout assignment's 'order-confidence % on clubs from that scout's district' - a scout whose home is one of the circuit's districts (formation.v1.json) reads its clubs' orders at 20, the best scout or stand-in counting

corner.text: NP_08 s1: a cornerman-in-training 'feeds the staff system' (NP_10 s6: 'staff level via use') - at a dual's end each trainee is one use for the dressed staffer below Lv3 with the fewest uses, else the corps' (the corps' order breaks ties)

home.text: NP_11 s9 Fighter.home_district: a generic's is the district the machine drew his lead in (NP_02 s1.1's Harbourline; the community centre when the card names none); a House card's is the House's root (NP_07 s8) on the circuit's districts; a houseless card's (and a House with no root on them) Millbrook Secondary

roles.text: PAC-099: NP_08 s1's stable roles beyond fighting - 'any stablemate can be assigned as a training partner, scout, or cornerman-in-training. Nobody rides the bench doing nothing'; NP_11 s9's stable_role FIGHTER / TRAINING / SCOUT / CORNER_TRAINEE. A role is set between duals on a stable card not dressed and works while he is on the bench (dressed, it waits). The per-10 lead, the cap, the district's 1 Prestige, the 20, the one use and the home districts beyond the docs' roots are first drafts

rep.text: PAC-101: NP_02 s2.1's district rep - 'mid-scrap flee costs small district rep (-1) - rep gates some recruit conditions'; NP_02 s4's rep as a gate (recruit conditions, vendor tiers); NP_08 s2.4's 'district rep milestones' paying Prestige. A scrap won in a district is +1 there and a flee after the first exchange -1 (never under 0; before it, fleeing is free); a scrap the overworld places nowhere moves no rep. REP(district, n) reads the ledger (the recruit table's and the houses' district names by their aliases; a seeded rep flag still counts). A milestone pays its Prestige the first time the district's rep reaches it. The milestones are small because NP_11 s6's Prestige 5-15 a session is scraps and rep together, and a story-pace session's scraps pay 13.5 of it; the rep per scrap, the flee's 1, the three milestones and their Prestige are first drafts

locker.text: PAC-100: NP_08 s4's locker room - 'browse by House crest wall, Style, Element, bond web, or slot-role. Comparison card: stats, techniques, trait, dialect, bond lines. Release (rare, reversible for 3 in-game days) frees cap space - released characters return to their district, remain re-recruitable, and remember (a small grudge/warmth flag; people aren't cartridges).' A card on the bench is released between duals: the stable's place freed at once, the role cleared, the gear back in the club's locker, the card off the Gym Wall, the ledgers kept under the name. Taken back before the third day turns, everything returns as it was; at the third, the card goes back - a recruit to the district (approachable again), a generic to the open mat. The flag is set as the card leaves: warmth with a bond at Lv1 or more to someone who stays, else a grudge. A warm recruit answers the approach at once; a grudging one wants the condition again and a spar won against the card since the release. A warm generic signs back free any day; a grudging one costs the priority even on an open-mat day. The story's four (NP_12A's Millbrook, the captain first - NP_02 s1.1: 'captain always slotted') are never released. The keep list, the Lv1 line and the flag's two effects are first drafts

4.text: NP_08 s5.2 Duo: the pair's named duo T3 (the library's duo_variant on a relay T3) is live for the second of the pair out when the first fought the segment before - by the bond, with or without a CHARGED relay (GDD s5.2: T3 by relay state or bonded adjacency); the partner's afterimage joins it (NP_05 s7); in the Exhibition 2v2 (NP_01 s8, PAC-088) the pair's true simultaneous duo moves - the library's sync_500ms festival moves, both inputs inside 500 ms (NP_05 s7)

5.text: NP_08 s5.2 Sworn: the Inheritance transformation between the pair unlocked (NP_09 s5) - each can take on the other's house style on the SURGE, where the other carries a house not his own (transformations.v1.json's inheritance tier); cross-house pairs: hybrid research opens (NP_08 s6, hybrids.v1.json)
